hook: Ex-Greyhounds, OCTOPUS chief now runs *TGSRTC* buses
hook_b: Ex-Greyhounds, OCTOPUS chief now runs *TGSRTC* buses
tldr: Senior IPS officer Dr Anil Kumar assumed charge as Vice-Chairman and Managing Director of TGSRTC at Bus Bhavan in Hyderabad on Monday.

beats.what: He was appointed by the State government on Nov 12 as part of the latest administrative changes.
beats.why: He previously held key police posts, including heading Operations, Greyhounds and OCTOPUS.
beats.care: He will oversee the administration and functioning of TGSRTC, which runs public bus services across Telangana.
